# AI · retrieval & memory

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Embeddings
- What: Numbers that capture what a piece of text means, so similar texts can be found.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### Vector database
- What: A database built to find the stored items closest in meaning to a query.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### RAG
- What: The AI first looks up relevant documents, then answers from them.
- Applies when: an AI model answers from the app's own documents.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Answers come from the retrieved documents. A question with no matching document gets an honest 'I don't know', not an invented answer.

### Chunking
- What: Split documents into small pieces so the right parts can be found and sent to the AI.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### Citations
- What: Show which documents an AI answer came from.
- Applies when: an AI model answers from the app's own documents.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Each answer shows which documents it used, and each reference opens the right source.

### Conversation memory
- What: Let an AI chat remember earlier messages, within the model's limits.
- Applies when: the app has an AI chat.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: A follow-up question that depends on earlier messages is answered correctly, and a long chat stays within the model's limit.

### Knowledge freshness
- What: Keep the documents the AI answers from up to date.
- Applies when: the documents an AI model answers from keep changing.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable
